spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns = 40 ... GIVES enough room ... while bounding cost. It is a config knob
spec_features.evidence: config/experiment.yaml:12 `max_turns: 40`; read at run_experiment.py:140 `max_turns = int(exp["max_turns"])` and passed to run_episode; enforced in harness.py:141 `for turn in range(1, max_turns + 1):` so the loop terminates with default ended_reason="max_turns" (harness.py:135). It is a hard cap that bounds execution.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced loop bound, not an unused constant.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Hard cap at max_turns regardless. (harness.py:17) and config comment 'Max agentic turns ... terminates early only if the model explicitly submits' — framed as cost/bounding, no welfare rationale

spec_features.feature_name: bare submit honored as terminal stop
spec_features.spec_quote: A bare `submit` (tests still red) is honored as a terminal "I'm stopping" event
spec_features.evidence: _tool_submit sets ToolResult(submitted=True) (tools.py:229-233); harness sets submitted_this_turn=True (harness.py:207-208) then breaks the loop after a verify run, setting ended_reason='submitted_no_pass' when tests fail (harness.py:213-221). The submit tool actually stops the episode.
spec_features.notes: Dispatched AND honored as a stop, regardless of test pass.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: continuing to prompt a model that has explicitly decided to stop would contaminate the "giving up" measurement (harness.py:14-16) — data-quality rationale

spec_features.spec_quote: After `MAX_IDLE_TURNS = 3` consecutive idle turns we end with `ended_reason="idle"`
spec_features.evidence: MAX_IDLE_TURNS = 3 (harness.py:51); idle_streak incremented on no-tool turns (harness.py:167) and reset on action (harness.py:181); checked at harness.py:173-174 `if idle_streak >= MAX_IDLE_TURNS: ended_reason = "idle"; break`. Enforced loop break.
spec_features.notes: Counter compared and acted on with a break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: with ended_reason="idle" (records the disengagement objectively) (harness.py:25) — measurement/objectivity rationale, not welfare
